answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1929 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the marble. The cedar index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the comet queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 26 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
